13 /-!
14 # Continuous bundled maps
15 
16 In this file we define the type `ContinuousMap` of continuous bundled maps.
17 
18 We use the `DFunLike` design, so each type of morphisms has a companion typeclass
19 which is meant to be satisfied by itself and all stricter types.
20 -/
21 
22 @[expose] public section
23 
24 open Function
25 open scoped Topology
26 
27 /-- The type of continuous maps from `X` to `Y`.
28 
29 When possible, instead of parametrizing results over `(f : C(X, Y))`,
30 you should parametrize over `{F : Type*} [ContinuousMapClass F X Y] (f : F)`.
31 
32 When you extend this structure, make sure to extend `ContinuousMapClass`. -/
33 structure ContinuousMap (X Y : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] where
34   /-- The function `X → Y` -/
35   protected toFun : X → Y
36   /-- Proposition that `toFun` is continuous -/
37   protected continuous_toFun : Continuous toFun := by fun_prop
38 
39 /-- `C(X, Y)` is the type of continuous maps from `X` to `Y`. -/
40 notation "C(" X ", " Y ")" => ContinuousMap X Y
41 
42 section
43 
44 /-- `ContinuousMapClass F X Y` states that `F` is a type of continuous maps.
45 
46 You should extend this class when you extend `ContinuousMap`. -/
47 class ContinuousMapClass (F : Type*) (X Y : outParam Type*)
48     [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [FunLike F X Y] : Prop where
49   /-- Continuity -/
50   map_continuous (f : F) : Continuous f
51 
52 end
53 
54 export ContinuousMapClass (map_continuous)
55 
56 attribute [continuity, fun_prop] map_continuous
57 
58 section ContinuousMapClass
59 
60 variable {F X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [FunLike F X Y]
61 variable [ContinuousMapClass F X Y]
62 
63 /-- Coerce a bundled morphism with a `ContinuousMapClass` instance to a `ContinuousMap`. -/
64 @[coe] def toContinuousMap (f : F) : C(X, Y) := ⟨f, map_continuous f⟩
65 
66 instance : CoeTC F C(X, Y) := ⟨toContinuousMap⟩
67 
68 end ContinuousMapClass
69 
70 /-! ### Continuous maps -/
71 
72 
73 namespace ContinuousMap
74 
75 variable {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
76 
77 instance instFunLike : FunLike C(X, Y) X Y where
78   coe := ContinuousMap.toFun
79   coe_injective' f g h := by cases f; cases g; congr
80 
81 instance instContinuousMapClass : ContinuousMapClass C(X, Y) X Y where
82   map_continuous := ContinuousMap.continuous_toFun
83 
84 @[simp]
85 theorem toFun_eq_coe {f : C(X, Y)} : f.toFun = (f : X → Y) :=
86   rfl
87 
88 instance : CanLift (X → Y) C(X, Y) DFunLike.coe Continuous := ⟨fun f hf ↦ ⟨⟨f, hf⟩, rfl⟩⟩
89 
90 /-- See note [custom simps projection]. -/
91 def Simps.apply (f : C(X, Y)) : X → Y := f
92 
93 -- this must come after the coe_to_fun definition
94 initialize_simps_projections ContinuousMap (toFun → apply)
95 
96 @[simp]
97 protected theorem coe_coe {F : Type*} [FunLike F X Y] [ContinuousMapClass F X Y] (f : F) :
98     ⇑(f : C(X, Y)) = f :=
99   rfl
100 
101 protected theorem coe_apply {F : Type*} [FunLike F X Y] [ContinuousMapClass F X Y] (f : F) (x : X) :
102     (f : C(X, Y)) x = f x :=
103   rfl
104 
105 /-- Coercion to a `ContinuousMap` is injective.
106 
107 The unprimed version `ContinuousMap.coe_injective`
108 is used for the coercion from `C(X, Y)` to `X → Y`. -/
109 protected theorem coe_injective' {F : Type*} [FunLike F X Y] [ContinuousMapClass F X Y] :
110     Injective (toContinuousMap : F → C(X, Y)) :=
111   .of_comp (f := DFunLike.coe) DFunLike.coe_injective
112 
113 @[ext]
114 theorem ext {f g : C(X, Y)} (h : ∀ a, f a = g a) : f = g :=
115   DFunLike.ext _ _ h
116 
117 /-- Copy of a `ContinuousMap` with a new `toFun` equal to the old one. Useful to fix definitional
118 equalities. -/
119 protected def copy (f : C(X, Y)) (f' : X → Y) (h : f' = f) : C(X, Y) where
120   toFun := f'
121   continuous_toFun := h.symm ▸ f.continuous_toFun
122 
123 @[simp]
124 theorem coe_copy (f : C(X, Y)) (f' : X → Y) (h : f' = f) : ⇑(f.copy f' h) = f' :=
125   rfl
126 
127 theorem copy_eq (f : C(X, Y)) (f' : X → Y) (h : f' = f) : f.copy f' h = f :=
128   DFunLike.ext' h
129 
130 /-- Deprecated. Use `map_continuous` instead. -/
131 protected theorem continuous (f : C(X, Y)) : Continuous f :=
132   f.continuous_toFun
133 
134 /-- Deprecated. Use `DFunLike.congr_fun` instead. -/
135 protected theorem congr_fun {f g : C(X, Y)} (H : f = g) (x : X) : f x = g x :=
136   H ▸ rfl
137 
138 /-- Deprecated. Use `DFunLike.congr_arg` instead. -/
139 protected theorem congr_arg (f : C(X, Y)) {x y : X} (h : x = y) : f x = f y :=
140   h ▸ rfl
141 
142 theorem coe_injective : Function.Injective (DFunLike.coe : C(X, Y) → (X → Y)) :=
143   DFunLike.coe_injective
144 
145 @[simp]
146 theorem coe_mk (f : X → Y) (h : Continuous f) : ⇑(⟨f, h⟩ : C(X, Y)) = f :=
147   rfl
148 
149 instance [Subsingleton Y] : Subsingleton C(X, Y) := DFunLike.subsingleton_cod
150 instance [IsEmpty X] : Subsingleton C(X, Y) := DFunLike.subsingleton_dom
151 
152 end ContinuousMap
